query:
SELECT pm.id, p.name, pm.date, pm.type, pm.quantity, pm.notes 
FROM productMovements pm 
JOIN products p ON pm.productId = p.id 
WHERE pm.companyId = 1 AND p.name LIKE '%Fumax%' 
ORDER BY pm.date DESC 
LIMIT 10;
